name: 18849-prefillheavy-kimilinear48b-tp2
model: moonshotai/Kimi-Linear-48B-A3B-Instruct, bf16, unquantized, ungated on HF. ~49 B parameters, ~98 GB of safetensors across 20 shards, ~3 B active per token. Serve it unquantized and do not substitute another checkpoint.
hardware: 2x H100 80GB HBM3, NVLink, two cards of one a3 node. No router, no external cache tier, no second node.
parallelism: TP=2, PP=1, DP=1, no expert parallelism, no speculative decoding. ~98 GB of bf16 weights needs TP>=2; at two cards that is ~49 GB per card.
architecture: KimiLinearForCausalLM, a 27-layer hybrid: 20 Kimi Delta Attention layers (linear, recurrent, fixed-size state per request) and 7 full MLA layers, sparse MoE with 256 routed experts at top-8 plus a shared expert. The rest is readable off the checkpoint's config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=32, warmup the first 10%, bounded at 640 requests with a 1800 s safety cap. ~576 measured requests.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix buckets and no prefix reuse: 4096 prompt tokens in, 128 output tokens out, both fixed (no stdev), `ignore_eos: true` and `temperature: 0.0`. Seed 18849.
purpose: A long-document analysis assistant on two GPUs, serving 32 concurrent users 4,000-word prompts with brief answers.
launch:
# The launch config, in `sglang serve` CLI form.
#
# FLAT PARSER: one `key: value` per line. An indented or nested block is DROPPED silently, which
# would run the engine without something this file claims to declare.

model-path: moonshotai/Kimi-Linear-48B-A3B-Instruct
tp-size: 2

# The checkpoint's tokenizer is remote code (tokenizer_config.json auto_map.AutoTokenizer).
trust-remote-code: true

enable-piecewise-cuda-graph: true

# 2048 rather than the 8192 H100 default: on this checkpoint `piecewise_cuda_graph_max_tokens` is a
# flat 2048 and is not derived from this key, so raising either one requires raising the other.
chunked-prefill-size: 2048

# Bounds the request-to-token table, which is allocated outside mem-fraction-static; the
# checkpoint's own model_max_length of 1048576 would cost gigabytes for a 4224-token maximum request.
context-length: 8192

random-seed: 42
